# SECURITY MODEL

<!-- Generated by sdk-web <specPhase> on 2026-11-02; updated 2026-11-02 for hard-coded v1 -->

v1 is a static site with no database, no auth and no user input.

- No secrets in the repo. The only env var is NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.
- Security headers in next.config.ts (CSP, X-Frame-Options DENY, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy). Never relax them without explicit instruction.
- External links use rel="noopener noreferrer".
- The contact email is shown publicly by the owner's choice. Render it as a mailto link.

When Supabase is added later, the rules from the sdk-web template apply: RLS on all tables, admin writes via is_admin(), anon SELECT only on published rows, never USING (TRUE).
